_comment: Current test scope. Set 2026-07-29 on instruction: the mobile app and the pendant are
not being tested; the web app IS a main target.
In focus:      SATE recorder · backend + AI pipeline · web app · PDF export · security
Out of focus:  mobile app (iOS/Android) · pendant / BLE accessory
Scope was assigned from each case's Components field, not by category name, because the
categories cut across surfaces — e.g. SATE-SEC-003 sits under Security but its components
are 'SATE Web App; Mobile App', so the web half stays in and the app half drops out.
In scope            Run it as written.
In scope (reduced)  Run it, but only the part that does not involve the app or pendant.
Deferred            Do not run. 'reason' says which surface put it out of scope.
Read by build-test-workbook.py, gen-system-test.py and the test runner. Change it here
TO PUT THE APP BACK IN SCOPE: set every 'Deferred - mobile app' entry to 'In scope' and
clear the reduced notes. Nothing else needs editing.

reduced_note.SATE-E2E-006: Repeat Stop / Save / Upload on the recorder only. Skip the app's Submit control.
reduced_note.SATE-NET-005: Recorder idle or asleep when connectivity returns. Skip phone background / screen-lock.
reduced_note.SATE-NET-006: Recorder's own network detection only. Skip the app's detection.
reduced_note.SATE-NET-007: Recorder behind the captive portal only. Skip the app.
reduced_note.SATE-LONG-006: Recorder battery, temperature, storage and backend processing time. Skip phone metrics.
reduced_note.SATE-SEC-003: Web app logout and token invalidation only. Skip mobile app logout.
reduced_note.SATE-COMP-003: Older recorder firmware against the current backend. Skip the older app build.
reduced_note.SATE-COMP-004: Recorder clock and stored timestamps. Skip phone clock skew.

run_note._comment: Cases whose Components read 'SATE Recorder OR Mobile App'. Fully in scope — just run the recorder path.
run_note.SATE-NET-004: Run the recorder's direct Wi-Fi upload path.
run_note.SATE-NET-008: Run the recorder's direct Wi-Fi upload path.
run_note.SATE-NET-009: Run the recorder's direct Wi-Fi upload path.
run_note.SATE-NET-010: Use the recorder's retry, or the web app's Retry control.
run_note.SATE-QUE-005: Restart the recorder, not the app.
run_note.SATE-LONG-004: Run the recorder's direct Wi-Fi upload path.

deferral_note.SATE-QUE-006: This case exists to prove the two delivery paths deduplicate. With the mobile app out of scope there is only one path in use, so the duplicate-session risk cannot materialise — but the gap it was written to catch (no database unique constraint behind the dedup probe) stays unproven. Run it before the app ships.
deferral_note.SATE-SEC-004: Pending-session isolation across an account switch is purely mobile-app local storage.
deferral_note.SATE-LONG-005: Phone lock and app backgrounding during a long recording. The recorder records standalone over Wi-Fi, so nothing here applies to the in-scope path.

coverage_impact._comment: Computed from the requirement links. Recheck after any scope change.

requirements_losing_all_coverage.note: Every case covering this requirement is a mobile-app case. Deferring the app leaves a REQUIRED requirement with zero test coverage. Acceptable only while the app is not shipping.

requirements_losing_most_coverage.note: Expected — most of the platform matrix is phone models and OS versions.
